building_area_ratio.description: Proportion of total image area identified as building structures.

road_area_ratio.description: Proportion of total image area identified as paved roads or transport networks.

water_area_ratio.description: Proportion of total image area identified as water bodies.

barren_area_ratio.description: Proportion of total image area identified as barren land or degraded ground.

forest_area_ratio.description: Proportion of total image area identified as forest cover.

agriculture_area_ratio.description: Proportion of total image area identified as agricultural land.

total_detected_objects.description: Total count of detected infrastructure objects within the scene.

object_density.description: Number of detected objects per unit area or standard tile.

mean_detection_confidence.description: Average detection confidence score across all identified bounding boxes.

building_water_proximity.description: Calculated minimum distance or spatial proximity between detected buildings and water bodies.

built_up_density.description: Combined built-up infrastructure density metric incorporating buildings and roads.

water_adjacency_score.description: Heuristic exposure score indicating the proportion of built-up infrastructure located directly adjacent to water bodies.
